title: Cloud-Drive Growth Runaway
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=clouddrive:usage
| timechart span=1w avg(used_gb) as used_gb
| delta used_gb as weekly_growth_gb
| eval runaway=if(weekly_growth_gb>5,1,0)
description: Flags weeks where cloud storage growth speeds up sharply.
value: Runaway storage growth usually means photo sync, backups, or large attachments are drifting without anyone noticing.
implementation: Track storage usage snapshots in `index=personal`; chart weekly growth and alert when the slope jumps.
visualization: Weekly line chart of used cloud storage with growth markers.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when your cloud storage starts growing much faster than normal, before it turns into a cost or cleanup problem.
